description: This file defines the Credentials class implementing AWS credential management, including handling access keys, secret keys, tokens, expiration, and serialization.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: Implementation of AWS Credentials interface, managing access key, secret key, token, expiration, and serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes credentials with key, secret, token, expiration, account ID, and source.

methods.name: __set_state
methods.description: Restores credentials object from exported state array.

methods.name: getAccessKeyId
methods.description: Returns the AWS access key ID.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Returns the AWS secret access key.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Restores credentials from serialized JSON string.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Returns credentials data as array for serialization.

methods.name: extendExpiration
methods.description: Extends the expiration time, used internally when IMDS is unreachable.
